title: LED blinks for ~33 s, then looks constantly on
user_question: The LED blinks every second for about 33 seconds, then looks constantly on (dimmer).

reference_context.title: Arduino Language Reference (arduino.cc)
reference_context.revision: arduino/reference-en master, last commit b367b025a1 (2025-04-11); rendered at docs.arduino.cc/language-reference
reference_context.section: Variables > Data Types > int; Functions > Time > millis() (Notes and Warnings)
reference_context.snippet: On the Arduino Uno (and other ATmega based boards) an int stores a 16-bit (2-byte) value. This yields a range of -32,768 to 32,767 (minimum value of -2^15 and a maximum value of (2^15) - 1). [millis():] The return value for millis() is of type `unsigned long`, logic errors may occur if a programmer tries to do arithmetic with smaller data types such as `int`.

expected.root_cause: lastBlink is a 16-bit int; after 32,767 ms the stored millis() value goes negative and is sign-extended in the unsigned long subtraction, so millis() - lastBlink is always >= 1000 and the LED toggles on every loop.
expected.fix: Declare unsigned long lastBlink and keep the rollover-safe form millis() - lastBlink >= interval; do not use millis() > lastBlink + interval.
